scenario: [LUNI.3.3]: the literal rule is for a unit literal only. A minus on anything else, here a slot, negates its stored base-unit value. `t: celsius` stores kelvin. Sensor `a` reads 273.15 K and `b` 268.15 K, and the rule `Reading r where -(r.t) < -270_kelvin` compares -273.15 and -268.15 with -270 K: `a` logs and `b` does not. (`-270_kelvin` is a literal in the base unit, so both readings give -270 K.) PATH PINNED: the arithmetic branch of `rlow_6_1_1_expr`'s unary arm in dsc.rete, `e_unop(op_neg, ...)` over the slot read. The break is applying the literal rule to every minus, converting -(the slot in °C) back to kelvin (546.3 - t), under which `a` gives 273.15 and nothing logs.
rules_ds:
unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15

schema Reading scope logical:
    sensor: String key
    t: celsius mutable

rule neg:
    Reading r where -(r.t) < -270_kelvin
->
    log info "{r.sensor}"
